column1: # Bounded reading corpus, crawled 2026-10-18 from the 50 seeds
# Rule: articles, collections, and sample-code pages reachable from each seed, recursively, inside the seed's framework path.
# Xcode and HIG seeds: depth 1 only (the seed and the pages it links), because those prefixes span the whole Xcode docs and the whole HIG.
# Symbol pages excluded. Counts include some case-variant duplicates (Xcode/ vs xcode/).
# Unbounded (whole HIG, whole Xcode docs): 934 articles, 1,089,531 words; 122 sample-code pages; 489 collections
